absence_policy: No page is generated for assessed zero or unassessed null. Preserve coverage and null versus zero; an unknown CIK is outside this fixed snapshot.
consumer_contract: Pin this manifest, validate schema and unique CIK/section/page membership, then verify selected page bytes/SHA256 and exact identity, snapshot, coverage, totals and pagination before rendering. Render source strings as inert text; only verified public records are included.

holdings_linkage.correspondence_scope: Exact source-reported FIGI strings against ten retained ticker-query mappings, not issuer-CIK or historical security associations. These are not holdings of the research cohort.
holdings_linkage.next_action: Obtain and independently review a permitted issuer-CIK to security-identifier association with class and effective dates. Until then keep company holdings unknown; do not attach candidate holdings by manager, name or ticker.
required_evidence: A permitted source explicitly binding reporting issuer CIK to the held security identifier, not the reporting manager CIK, company name or ticker similarity.
Security-class and identifier scope (CUSIP/FIGI/composite/share class), including option or debt distinctions, verified rather than inferred from a checksum.
Effective historical identity intervals covering each report period and corporate actions; a current mapping cannot establish past ownership.
Source filing/amendment/confidentiality context and observation/publication clocks before any ownership or decision-time inference.

interpretation: Exact CIK groups separately sourced research evidence, not an event, causal relationship, aligned time window or security identity.
Only this fixed 108-company snapshot is supported. Later findings and wider issuer directories are not implicitly incorporated.
Financial prepared end dates are coarse reported context keys, not independently verified exact accounting durations. Numerical equality or difference does not establish comparability or restatement.
Insider P/S rows include open-market or private transactions; source filing-quarter coverage is not transaction-time coverage or evidence of intent.
Disclosure concepts are filing review candidates, not confirmed deals. Reported financing/revenue findings retain their own source limits.
Unassessed/out-of-snapshot counts are null. An assessed zero is only no selected record in that source scope. Empty pagination is not absence.
Source objects are returned unchanged from public artifacts. No network access verifies original links or present availability.
